subject: Banking
title: First Republic Bank: The Wealth Bank
description: A quick, practical guide to First Republic Bank: The Wealth Bank.

hook.text: First Republic catered to wealthy clients in San Francisco and New York.

buildup.text: First Republic offered jumbo mortgages at below-market rates to attract wealthy depositors.

discovery.text: When SVB failed, wealthy depositors panicked and pulled $100 billion from First Republic despite reassurances.

twist.text: 11 major banks deposited $30 billion to rescue First Republic. It wasn't enough.

climax.text: First Republic proved that even serving the wealthy doesn't prevent bank runs.

punchline.text: Served the wealthy. Lost $100 billion in deposits.

quiz.question: What happened to the $30 billion rescue deposit for First Republic?
options: It wasn't enough, and JPMorgan acquired the bank anyway
